Requires fault-injection support the app does not expose (TestScenarios.md RECOV-01 — "Manual, requires fault injection at process level").

Not automatable against the shared test-run backend: restarting it mid-scenario would break every other test running concurrently against the same instance (Playwright runs fully parallel). Verifying this would require its own fully isolated frontend+backend pair, which is out of scope for this pass (TestScenarios.md RECOV-03 — "Manual").
